name: Otter.ai
tagline: Meeting transcription, summaries, and AI chat over conversations

pricing.notes: Official pricing page URL checked; public secondary coverage in 2026 lists Pro at $16.99/month and about $100/year.

verdictSummary: You can build transcription and summaries, but Otter's value includes live meeting assistant behavior, account sync, speaker workflow, integrations, and mobile/web reliability.
coreLoopDIY: Use a meeting bot or local recorder, run transcription, diarize speakers, summarize, then expose search/chat over transcripts.
requirements: calendar/video-call integration if bot-style capture is desired
whyPeopleStillPay: They pay for capture reliability and shared searchable meeting memory, not just the transcript file.

priorArt.name: whisperX
priorArt.desc: Open-source transcription alignment and diarization tooling useful for DIY Otter-like work

notes: Recognizable but not trivial; good example of transcription being easy while production capture is not.
prompt:
Build me a personal replacement for Otter.ai (Meeting transcription, summaries, and AI chat over conversations). Requirements:

- Core loop: Use a meeting bot or local recorder, run transcription, diarize speakers, summarize, then expose search/chat over transcripts.
- Needs: speech-to-text API or local Whisper.
- Needs: storage/search index.
- Needs: calendar/video-call integration if bot-style capture is desired.
- Keep it personal-scale: no accounts, no telemetry, secrets in .env, SQLite or
  flat files for storage. Local-first wherever possible.
- Clean minimal UI where one is needed; CLI is fine where one is not.
- Include a README with setup steps, required keys, and any OS permissions.

Honest scope: this covers the core loop only. You will not get: live bot joining meetings; speaker diarization quality; mobile apps.
